officialBasis.reference: FAQ v2.1 question 33, Act 4 section 2(24) wage definition

rule: Include monetary remuneration payable under the contract of service, including leave, holiday, overtime and extra holiday work. Exclude employer statutory contributions, travelling allowance/concession, special employment expenses, gratuity/retirement payments, annual bonus and minister-prescribed exclusions.

classifications.rationale: Leave-period remuneration is expressly within the wage definition.
Overtime remuneration is expressly within the wage definition.
Remuneration for work on a rest day is holiday or extra work remuneration.
Holiday and extra holiday work remuneration are expressly included.
Commission paid for service is monetary remuneration and is not an express exclusion.
Employment incentive is monetary remuneration and is not an express exclusion.
Annual bonus is excluded, but the generic component does not prove annual versus non-annual character.
The source salary may be remuneration, but the canonical period and correction treatment require human classification.
The generic code can represent remuneration, travelling allowance or expense reimbursement.
